verdict.rationale: Godot runs an official Asset Library with categories for 2D/3D tools, shaders, materials, scripts, templates, projects and demos, plus a queryable JSON API, and its editor plugin system lets those add-ons extend the editor. Nothing in the evidence shows the library is large, and no category covers ready-made models. Missing for 10: evidence of the ecosystem's scale ('large'), a model/art asset offering, any marketplace or commercial store, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the library's breadth and quality.
